name: Land Cruiser BJ60
stock_transmission: H42 4-speed manual (H41F/H42F, A440F automatic, and H55F 5-speed also cited in some markets)
notes: Diesel counterpart to the gas FJ60/FJ62 on the same 60-series body - reusing that body's bay envelope. Never offered with a turbo despite some sources conflating it with 70-series 13B-T options. Years/hp have some source disagreement.
